d: We are seeking an experienced and professional driver to support senior executives and their families. The role requires discretion, reliability, a courteous approach and excellent knowledge of both Jeddah and Riyadh.
Provide safe and punctual transportation for executives, family members and guests.
Handle airport transfers, business appointments, family trips and errands.
Plan routes effectively, taking traffic conditions and changing schedules into account.
Maintain strict confidentiality and respect family privacy.
Keep vehicles clean, well-maintained and ready for use.
Follow traffic regulations, safety standards and company policies.
Promptly report vehicle issues and coordinate servicing.
Requirements • At least three years of driving experience in Saudi Arabia, including supporting executives and families.
Valid Saudi driving licence and a safe driving record.
Excellent knowledge of both Jeddah and Riyadh, districts and key locations, alongside strong familiarity with Jeddah.
Ability to communicate in Arabic and English.
Professional appearance, respectful conduct and a strong sense of responsibility.
Flexibility to accommodate executive and family schedules, including travel to Riyadh as required. Employment Type: Full-time
